prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 cinematic 3D animated-style scene in a warm sunlit kitchen about dirty produce and invisible germs. In the foreground on a rustic wooden countertop, show exactly 5 anthropomorphic vegetables/fruits with worried cartoon faces: 1 large red apple in the center with big eyes, raised brown eyebrows, open anxious mouth, water droplets, dirt specks, a stem and one green leaf; 1 red tomato at front left with big eyes and shocked open mouth; 1 pale green lettuce/cabbage head at back left with large eyes, frightened mouth, dirt splashes, and leafy folds; 1 tall orange carrot at back right with leafy green top, dirt on its skin, big eyes and sad frown; 1 small broccoli head partly hidden at far right with worried eyes. Add exactly 7 visible small pests on the produce: 1 cute brown snail with eye stalks sitting on the lettuce, 1 green caterpillar crawling on the apple, 3 black flies with translucent wings perched on the apple/tomato/leaf area, and 2 tiny worm-like bugs near the tomato edge. Scatter clumps of dark soil and crumbs across the table and on the produce. At bottom right foreground, place a large handheld magnifying glass angled over the apple, revealing enlarged colorful cartoon microbes inside the lens, including round spiky germs and rod-shaped bacteria in green, yellow, orange, and red, sharply detailed compared with the rest of the scene. Background: cozy kitchen with shallow depth of field, potted plants on a sunny windowsill, sink and jars softly blurred. Include two framed signs: on the left wall a cream poster with hand-lettered Spanish text FRUTAS Y VERDURAS MÁS LIMPIAS = UNA FAMILIA MÁS SANA and a small red heart below; on the right a black chalkboard with white chalk Spanish text LO QUE NO VES TAMBIÉN IMPORTA. Visual style: high-quality Pixar-like clay/stop-motion 3D, expressive oversized eyes, tactile vegetable textures, realistic dirt and water droplets, macro photography feeling, warm golden morning light, soft bokeh, crisp foreground focus, wholesome public-health advertisement mood. Use dirty fruits and vegetables as the scene theme, with warm golden kitchen sunlight and concerned but charming and educational. Avoid logos, watermarks, extra text, extra produce characters, or additional pests beyond the counted visible items.

promptZh: 创建一个垂直 9:16 的电影级 3D 动画风格场景，背景为温暖阳光下的厨房，主题是脏污的农产品和肉眼不可见的细菌。在前景的乡村风木质台面上，展示 5 个拟人化的蔬菜/水果，它们有着忧虑的卡通表情：中心是一个大红苹果，有着大眼睛、上扬的棕色眉毛、张开的焦虑嘴巴，带有水珠、污垢斑点、果梗和一片绿叶；左前方是一个红番茄，有着大眼睛和震惊张开的嘴；左后方是一个浅绿色生菜/卷心菜头，有着大眼睛、惊恐的嘴、泥土飞溅和叶片褶皱；右后方是一根高大的橙色胡萝卜，带有绿叶顶端、表皮污垢、大眼睛和悲伤的皱眉；右侧远处是一个半遮掩的小西兰花头，有着担忧的眼神。在农产品上添加 7 只清晰可见的小害虫：生菜上坐着 1 只带有眼柄的可爱棕色蜗牛，苹果上爬着 1 只绿色毛毛虫，苹果/番茄/叶片区域停着 3 只带有半透明翅膀的黑蝇，番茄边缘附近有 2 只微小的蠕虫状小虫。在桌面上和农产品上散落着成团的深色土壤和碎屑。在右下角前景处，放置一个大型手持放大镜，倾斜覆盖在苹果上方，通过镜片揭示出放大的彩色卡通微生物，包括绿色、黄色、橙色和红色的圆形尖刺状细菌及杆状细菌，与场景其余部分相比细节极其锐利。背景：温馨的厨房，浅景深，阳光充足的窗台上摆放着盆栽，水槽和罐子呈现柔和的虚化效果。包含两个带框标志：左侧墙上是一张奶油色海报，上面有手写西班牙语文本 FRUTAS Y VERDURAS MÁS LIMPIAS = UNA FAMILIA MÁS SANA，下方有一个红色小爱心；右侧是一块黑色黑板，上面有白色粉笔书写的西班牙语文本 LO QUE NO VES TAMBIÉN IMPORTA。视觉风格：高质量皮克斯风格粘土/定格动画 3D，富有表现力的大眼睛，真实的蔬菜纹理，逼真的污垢和水珠，微距摄影感，温暖的金色晨光，柔和的焦外成像，清晰的前景焦点，健康的公共卫生广告氛围。使用 dirty fruits and vegetables 作为场景主题，配合 warm golden kitchen sunlight 和 concerned but charming and educational。避免出现标志、水印、额外文字、额外的农产品角色，或超出规定数量的害虫。
